title: EuroLeague Final Four 2025
metaDescription: The 2025 EuroLeague Final Four was held in Abu Dhabi, where Fenerbahçe won the European championship.

overview.about: The EuroLeague Final Four is the climax of European club basketball, bringing the continent's four best teams together for two semi-finals and a final over one weekend. It is the biggest prize in the sport outside the NBA, and Real Madrid are its most decorated club.
overview.nextEvent: The next EuroLeague Final Four is staged over a single weekend at a neutral host arena, this edition in Abu Dhabi. Four clubs contest the semi-finals and final, with the champions crowned on the Sunday.

@graph.name: EuroLeague Final Four 2025
@graph.description: The 2025 EuroLeague Final Four was staged at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, the first Final Four held outside Europe. Fenerbahçe beat Monaco 81–70 in the championship game to win its second EuroLeague title.
